source: Modern decoder-only ZXNAME0000XZ often use Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE). RoPE does not alter the residual stream by adding a positional vector toZXMATH0000XZ Instead, standard RoPE applies position-dependent rotations to query and key components before their dot products are evaluated.
zh: 现代仅解码器 ZXNAME0000XZ 通常使用旋转位置嵌入 (RoPE)。 RoPE 不会通过向 ZXMATH0000XZ 添加位置向量来改变残差流，相反，标准 RoPE 在计算点积之前对查询和关键组件应用位置相关的旋转。
